title: Sukumaaruda – Hosanna Ministries Telugu Christian Lyrics

ghanulaku ledhee ee shubha tharunam naakidhi nee bhaagyamaa

intro: Sukumaaruda is the latest Telugu Christian song from the album, Dayakshetram (Vol-35) released by Hosanna Ministries featuring Senior Pastor, Singer, song-writer, Pastor Abraham and music arranged by renowned christian music director, Pranam Kamlakhar. This song video was released on March 06, 2025 through Hosanna Ministries YouTube channel.
